newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QBE says on target for yr profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QBE says on target for yr profit rise.

text.p: QBE Insurance Group Ltd said on Monday it was on target for an increased profit for the year to June 30, 1997.

"QBE is on target for an increased profit this year with our current forecasts providing encouragement that a continuation of growth in shareholders' wealth can be expected," the company said in a statement accompanying its first year results.
QBE earlier reported a rise in net profit for the half year to December 31, 1996 to A$85.4 million from A$83 million previously.
The insurance group said it expected Australian general insurance operations to achieve annual premium growth above 10 percent and to maintain insurance profits.
It expected international general insurance operations in the Asia-Pacific to continue to grow at 10 percent this financial year and increase thereafter.
QBE said its reinsurance division should capitalise on strong premium growth, with a continuing focus on specialty lines compensating for increased competition.
Initiatives already in place should see solid growth in group net earned premium and a fall in the expense ratio.
QBE also said changes to boost productivity had improved its Australian general insurance operations, and further improvements were expected next financial year.
It planned to export suitable techniques to its larger branch and subsidiary offices overseas.
